overview: Cricket Master Quiz is a single-player cricket trivia game with multiple-choice questions across Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels. Players earn coins for correct answers, maintain daily login streaks for bonus rewards, and compete on a global leaderboard — all with a bold dark gaming UI matching the Cricket Master branding.
features: Cricket trivia questions about players, IPL, World Cup, and records
4-option multiple choice with 10-second timer per question
Coins reward system: Easy=10, Medium=25, Hard=50 per correct answer
Daily login streak rewards with milestone bonuses
Easy, Medium, and Hard difficulty levels
Dark gaming UI with gold and red accents
